# James Delos Reyes

> Full-stack engineer in Cebu, Philippines with 8+ years across React/TypeScript
> frontends and Node.js backends, currently building an AI-powered recruitment
> platform (Jobvious). Specializes in end-to-end feature ownership: UI, API
> integration, and AI features (OpenAI, RAG pipelines, Qdrant vector search).

## Current role

Full Stack Developer at Jobvious (Apr 2025 – present) — AI-powered recruitment
and referral platform. TypeScript workspace of 11 services: React SPAs (Vite),
NestJS APIs, MySQL/Prisma, Redis, Socket.io, OpenAI-powered matching with
Qdrant vector search.

- Designed and built the full redesign of the admin platform: a 9-module
  React + TypeScript SPA on a custom design system with hand-coded SVG data
  visualizations. Case study: /case-studies/jobvious/
- Built AI chat support (OpenAI) for profile completion, job-matching queries,
  and referral guidance.
- Shipped participant-facing onboarding, resume upload, and referral workflows
  plus real-time messaging over Socket.io.

## Previous roles

- Senior Software Engineer, Accenture (2022–2025) — Appwards, the retailer
  loyalty platform for Philip Morris International (ph.pmiandu.com: retailers
  redeem pack promo codes for points), and an internal file-storage system
  used by Accenture teams globally (Mexico, PH, UK, Ireland...).
  Case study: /case-studies/accenture/
- Back End Developer, GoTeam (2021–2022) — for client Black Moth (intelligent
  machine vision systems for mining and road infrastructure): built the web
  application's backend — APIs serving the vision system's route-tied defect
  captures from AWS S3 into the web app, where operators review defects and
  track growth across passes. Case study: /case-studies/goteam/
- Software Engineer, Tech Mahindra (2020–2021) — one-click semi-automation of
  CSR agents' manual daily tasks (C#/.NET), ~40% efficiency gain.
  Case study: /case-studies/tech-mahindra/
- Software Engineer, M Lhuillier Financial Services (2018–2020) — migrated the
  nationwide pawn-system teller tools from C# desktop to React web, retiring
  the branch-local server + sync-tool layer. Case study: /case-studies/mlhuillier/

## AI engineering

Ships AI inside products, not just AI-assisted coding: OpenAI chat support in
production (profile completion, job-match questions, referral guidance) and a
matching pipeline (jobs/candidates → OpenAI embeddings → Qdrant vector search
→ scored matches). Treats models as unreliable dependencies: validated
structured outputs, fallbacks, observability. Currently going deeper into RAG
pipelines, embedding strategy, and self-hosted models.

Query, Zustand, MySQL, PostgreSQL.
Working knowledge: NestJS, Prisma, Socket.io, OpenAI API, Docker, GitHub
Actions, Vitest, MongoDB, AWS S3.
Familiar: Redis, BullMQ, Qdrant, RAG pipelines, Playwright, Strapi.
